title: SIA Configuration API
description: Akamai's Secure Internet Access (SIA) Configuration API offers a programmatic interface to manage policy settings to protect against enterprise security and acceptable user policy related events. A distributed configuration encapsulates all the rules for how to process DNS requests for your enterprise.
